subject: 胡同院落
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. ONE isolated transparent sprite for a realistic historical Chinese town game. Early-to-mid Qing NORTH CHINA, anonymous Beijing/Shengjing/Jinan architectural concept, not a specific monument reconstruction. Match the attached Song asset ONLY for realistic material texture, fine detail density, restrained weathering, lighting and game sprite rendering; CHANGE architectural forms to Qing northern grey-brick, grey-tile and dark timber. Orthographic DIMETRIC, yaw45 elevation30, STRICT 2:1 ground plane, east ground axis screen lower-right slope +0.5 and north upper-right slope -0.5, parallel lines NO perspective convergence. South doorway faces screen lower-left. Draw a thin rectangular ground boundary, entire footprint with visible left, front and right corners, NO thick floating base. Keep the entire sprite and soft contact shadow inside generous 10% transparent margins. TRUE transparent RGBA background. Light from screen UPPER LEFT, short soft contact shadow lower-right. Grey fired brick, matte grey barrel tiles with straight sober ridges, northern hard-gable walls, dark brown wooden lattice windows, no Jiangnan whitewashed tourist style. No text, pseudo-writing, plaques, characters, people, flags, modern objects, sky, horizon, landscape, trees, water or road outside footprint, no saturated lighting, cartoon, plastic, borders or watermark. A compact single-storey siheyuan courtyard compound: grey brick perimeter, north main house, east/west wing rooms, small south gate, interior unobstructed courtyard with modest paving. Grey hard-gable tiled roofs, dark wood lattice windows and simple recessed brick entrance. Footprint 10m east-west by8m north-south.
negative: 文字、人物、水印、现代物、背景场景、厚地台、裁边、透视汇聚

projection_contract.note: 投影目标，不宣称生成图精确满足；实测见geometry_qa。

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize rounded to integer dimensions
paste without mask on transparent canvas, minimum 16px margins; no repaint/warp/flip/alpha threshold
crop alpha>0 bbox and restore transparent padding

geometry_qa.measurement_note: 审核人工测点经同一PIL仿射矩阵变换；锚点取校正后L/R底面中点。

notes: 2候选选1；RGBA合成确认原图无实际光晕，第1候选轴率和占地比例更近目标，仍有严格几何残差。；匿名北方建筑组合（原创扩展），待作者审批。 第10轮按审核裁定仅作PIL仿射几何校正；双轴进入0.40–0.62，仍为candidate。
